يقتبلون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَبِلُونَ (yaqtabilūna) /jaq.ta.bi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# يُقْتَبَلُونَ (yuqtabalūna) /juq.ta.ba.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
